name: hinmil
description: Hindley-Milner type checking for plain JavaScript: type signatures in comments, no build step. Command-line checker and language server
author: Rafael Tureluren

scripts.prepack: npm --prefix ../.. run build && rm -rf dist hm-types-builtin schemas && cp -R ../../dist dist && rm -f dist/extension.js dist/extension.js.map dist/extension.d.ts dist/extension.d.ts.map && cp -R ../../hm-types-builtin hm-types-builtin && cp -R ../../schemas schemas && cp ../../README.md README.md && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
